note: The media-URL rewrite rules, as a contract both producers are held to. Loaded by extension/test/extractors.test.js (against src/extractors/base.js) and by AtelierCapture/Tests/AtelierCaptureTests/PageExtractorTests.swift (against PageExtractor). See 096 review issue 1A and .change-log/404 for why a comment was not enough.

toOrigName.case: a name= parameter is rewritten to orig
webp is switched to jpg alongside the rewrite — twimg 404s the pair, and the caller then silently captures the rendered size (422, and the reason both sides carry this rule at all)
already orig but still webp is still repaired
a bare URL is left alone — only a URL already carrying name= is rewritten
a format without a name is left alone, webp included: the webp repair rides the name rewrite and does not happen on its own

toOriginals.case: a single-dimension size segment becomes originals
a two-dimension size segment does too
a non-size segment is not a size — no rewrite
a size segment elsewhere in the path is not the one replaced
